company_line: AGT designs and builds ground retention for civil, rail and tunnelling projects in Sydney, and is growing its Keystone Retaining Walls division.
subject: Junior Civil Engineer, Retaining Walls
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Civil Engineer role in AGT's Keystone Retaining Walls division, advertised on SEEK and in your recent LinkedIn post. The mix of retaining wall design, estimates and time on site for set-out and inspections is the start I want.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. There I designed and documented earthworks, road geometry, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, and applied AS 1726 and AS 1289 in coursework.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings and carried out inspections and quality checks. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I tracked materials and wrote site and progress reports.

I have an Australian driver's licence, my own transport and a White Card, and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. I have not used PLAXIS or designed retaining walls on a job, so I would value the training your team offers.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
